notes.title: Welcome to Chaos Mode - now available for everyone!
notes.content:
Headsup, commander trash! The universe is ours! In order to unlock the full potential of our forces, [b]the RULES of CHAOS are now enabled! [/b]We may choose the difficulty of our missions by applying modifiers to a dimension, for ex: we can increase HP or Damage for our enemies and suffer the consequences! If we comply with the requirements and generate enough chaos points, the top brass will grant a great reward for us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787243/eb97fe6e51e064c64da4ca3ee78d6b560277cd9e.png[/img]

Bit confused? Naaa, it's simple. Here's how CHAOS works, in a nutshell:

[list]
[*] Add difficulty modifiers
[*] Fill your CHAOSMETER for each level of modifiers applied
[*] If you defeat certain bosses and fulfill the required chaos points you will unlock a new special card that will appear on future runs
[/list]

Hope you're up for the challenge! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787243/afc110c94f84ccd337fa6476564ff77b7d196386.png[/img]

Oh, and before we wrap up and leave you to embrace CHAOS... We are part of the Made in Brazil sale, starting today at 7PM CET, with a [b]35% discount on the base game and 30% on the OST.[/b]

[i]- Ota Imon/Raw Fury[/i]

notes.title: Chaos Mode Is Here (Well the Beta is)
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Are you ready for CHAOS???

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787243/b14467331849ae9c1f847255360535203de0abe3.jpg[/img]

First of all, thank you so much for the supportive comments, upvoting and general feedback from our last update. We have a small but very bustling community here and I can't overstate how much that feedback resonates with us and keeps us motivated.


We're very happy that we managed to deliver on a specific requests such as initial controller support, controls for Steamdeck support and a difficulty curve adjustments to make the game more enjoyable and accessible. We are still working on these features more to make them the best they can be so thank you for your continued feedback.


We're still working through our list of nice-to-haves as well as some other critical features. We are however. a little blocked by our team size, and access to various support channels such as QA which we had prior to our launch.


Taking a queue from our peer developers, we are going to try and solve this problem, but we need your help to do it.


What we propose is a separate test branch, we're calling the [b]Public Test Realm. [/b](I'll refer to it as PTR from here, a little nod to our MMO days)


This PTR can be accessed by anyone who owns a copy of the game. You are effectively moving over to a pre-release patch which we're still working on, testing ourselves and trying to ensure it's stability before we put it into the default branch of the game which everyone plays on.

We will of course ensure a certain level of QA is done before we update this branch. However, other than an initial smoke test of booting, key features, and a respectable enough playthrough, the build should absolutely be considered to have bugs and experience tweaks that might not be perfectly tuned, yet.


This is where your feedback and support would be greatly appreciated.

Before you move to this branch, you should copy your current save file to your desktop so that you can use it later on IF you run into any catstrophic bugs in the test. 

Simply copy this folder somewhere safe and you can place it back in the same location later on:

C:\Users\(your windows username)\AppData\LocalLow\OTA IMON\Zet Zillions

We can talk more about it in this Steam thread. For now I'll move on to telling you how to access it.

[b]How to Access:[/b]

[b]Code:[/b] PublicTestPass777

[olist]
[*] Right click on Zet Zillions in your Steam library
[*] Choose Properties
[*] Choose Betas
[*] Enter the above Code and press Check Code
[*] Choose the accept button
[*] Confirm that your library build updates and your game now says Zet Zillions [Public_Test_Realm]
[/olist]


The notes for this build are the following. The first two will be of particular interest to a number of our players.


[list]
[*] Added Challenge Mode [BETA VERSION]
[*] Player can now select previous chapters to replay story
[*] Fixed issue with Captain Trash
[*] Added Nix Phase One to Zillionspedia
[*] Added Coelho to Zillionspedia
[*] Added Pedroka to Zillionspedia
[*] Fixed issue music from credits
[*] Added Main Menu new transitions
[*] Enemies shield size and position review
[*] Fixed some escape animation from enemies
[*] Fixed Void Buzard animation
[*] Added new music to credits after chapter 7
[*] Fixed issue that causes some cards to lose its arts when player change act
[*] Added reward ui to some map events options to show correctly player's reward
[*] Fixed Frail effect description
[*] Fixed duplicated tooltips
[*] Review Accumulate Resources Missions
[*] Fixed day to start thanatos protocol
[*] Unload card buff
[*] Raw Fury card buff
[*] Trash Engineer card buff
[*] Junk Turret card buff
[*] Mr. Claw card buff
[/list]


Regarding the Challenge mode. For now, this is a draft version of what SHOULD feel like a sort of daily run, or lunchtime run mode. We want it to be a lot of fun, easy to access, a challenge curve that can be adjusted, and eventually a reward system, that will give you cards and boons which will be available in the regular campaign runs of ZZ as well as this mode.

In short, you pick a series of debuffs to help increase the Chaos Metre making the game measurably harder, pursue victory even with these difficulty mods in place, and get a killer reward if you're successful. We're still designing the rewards so this is a beta for now but we would LOVE to hear what you think of it.

More info on all of that soon.


For now I'm going to wrap it up here as this is a very long post.

I just want to say thank you thank you thank you for the positive reviews we've been receiving lately. We went from a 74% position to 90% over the past two months slowly but surely. We're so happy to see this sentiment improve and to bring ZZ to the level that everyone wants to see it achieve.
If you have any issues please let us know and we'll get back to you as soon as we can.


[b]RF/OTA IMON[/b]

notes.title: Patch 1.3 is Live
notes.content:
Well hello there,

Seeing as this is our third patch this week, most of you know what to expect. The patch addresses outstanding issues, progress softlocks, repaired enemy actions and some other bug crushing code implementation.

We have heard all of your feedback this week and wanted to introduce a substantial quality of life tweak which many of you will be very happy to hear. An XP Multiplier which is distributed across the main game arc, ie, XP gaaaaaaaaains!

In essence it will multiply all XP earned in each chapter, drastically improving progression. For example, Chapter 2 will give you double,  Chapter 3 will give you triple and so on. This will really speed up the amount you gain, but not affect how much is required for the unlocks. 

This was the surest and fastest way we could design this enhancement without throwing other systems out of whack but please continue to provide feedback for us so we can measure how it feels over a longer player experience curve. 

[list]
[*] Added new Experience Multiply per Chapter to improve players progression
[*] Fixed issue where mouse cursor could be disabled during card selection screen
[*] Fixed issue where increase fusion card with exile status would never be exiled
[*] Reward selection highlight now disabled when moving mouse cursor off from card
[*] Fixed mission selection screen opening with no missions available
[*] Fix mission dialogue interaction with narrative node dialogue
[*] Thanatos Zero will now kill hes arms when he dies
[*] Fixed Valkyrie effects execution order
[*] Added Animation to Dok's Exilir card
[*] Fixed issue with Super Nova trait
[*] Added Gilgamon Portrait
[/list]


Ideally we need to cool off this weekend and take some much needed time to go touch grass. We feel like the build is in a good place across the majority of the community, though we still have outlier players with save files that need to be replaced due to progress corruptions from earlier issues we all faced.

Please continue to report such issues to the helpdesk and to me directly and we'll do our best to get you a file similar to where you left off. 

That said, the fastest quick fix is to delete your save, and dive back in with a fresh run. 

You can do this by turning off steam cloud, going to the following path on your hard drive, deleting the Zet Zillions folder, and starting again. It's not ideal, but it can get you going immediately.

C:\Users\(your windows username)\AppData\LocalLow\OTA IMON

Thank you for the continued support and encouragement since we launched last week. It has been a major driver for us to really push through these improvements as fast as we have been.


I'll leave the notes there for now and ya'll can get back into the game. 


Enjoy your weekend

Ota Imon/Raw Fury

notes.title: DevBlog #4 - The population mechanic
notes.content:
Hey! Did you know that in Zet Zillions you can throw your own people at your enemies?

By using certain cards, you can increase your opponents’ populations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787243/d261ed0a70a5d401d5954834dc50bb594ef30ccf.png[/img]

Each enemy has a limit to how many people can be thrown at them, and once that limit is reached, they become staggered for a moment, giving you time to build up your defenses, or hit them even harder!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787243/a817fa226389db9dbd27ec6d77b22bb163e0d0e3.png[/img]

But there’s more! Lots of cards can also affect and be affected by the enemies’ populations, allowing you to perform crazy combos!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787243/b8c1232fbd411ae5db2f4ef9c079f0a9dc7abe30.png[/img]

[h2]What about planets?[/h2]

Planets are a special type of enemy, as they cannot become staggered. Instead, once you fill up their population gauge, you colonize them and win the battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787243/8be2158364767a01b46a88b1bbe33c263e960cfb.png[/img]

Colonizing planets will grant you big rewards! But be aware, this is not an easy task, they will do all sorts of things to try and stop you.

That’s it for now! We hope you have fun populating and colonizing enemies. Play the demo now and try it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2229560

notes.title: DevBlog #3 - An intro to the fusion system
notes.content:
Hey! You know what's cool? [b]FUSIONS[/b]! Let's talk about them.

Since the beginning of this project, we wanted to make a card game where you could combine stuff into something useful to shoot at your enemies, and that’s exactly what we did! In Zet Zillions, you make fusions of cards to create powerful, deadly and even dangerous new cards.

[h2]How it works[/h2]

In combat, you can combine cards on your hand by dragging one over the other and clicking on it. By doing this, you merge the two cards and get a new one, with its own effects and synergies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787243/9642cd56b96eb6f67bb3854637331ffb85a3471d.png[/img]

Almost every card in the game can be combined with many others, resulting in lots of fusions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787243/46e5e1a13c4dc7b2c81c5b15ee9cf486721d2ed3.png[/img]

There are also multiple ways to get the same fusion result, giving the player more freedom to choose the cards they want in their deck.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787243/7e37d7e3f0a041345c433a97bb3623483643b94b.png[/img]

But that’s not all, some cards also have effects that are activated when they are fused.

So this was a glimpse at our fusion system. We had to go through A LOT of trial and error to make it work, but I can say we're pretty happy with how it turned out.

As a core feature of the game, we did our best to make it as intuitive and easy to understand as possible.

There are more than 100 combinations in our game. We encourage you to explore and try all you can find!

notes.title: DevBlog #1 - From Wolfstride to Zet Zillions: Concept Art, Lore and More
notes.content:
Hey there! This is Ota Imon from... well, Ota Imon Studio. Let's chat a bit about the journey from Wolfstride to Zet Zillions!

Going from the Black & White Mecha Wolfstride Universe to the colorful chaotic card battle that is Zet Zillions was really hard. We had to get out of our comfort zone, and to deliver the best experience we could, we brought our art style, the infamous dialogues and story, to a more “gameplay focused” environment.

[previewyoutube=WQj-gqNAFzU;full][/previewyoutube]

You probably know it by now, but Zet Zillions is very different from Wolfstride, though they share the same DNA. Experimenting with different card combinations, fusions, and effects was a real blast. However, the most difficult part for us was working with colors! We had lots of help until we could settle on the right color palette. Yup, at first we were only painting things with any colors we wanted, like throwing a very colorful spaghetti to a wall. Took us several meetings to make the colors fit our vibrant chaotic universe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787243/defd86df5545fde85ee82149749cac3b6969923a.png[/img]

Wolfstride was also very linear and story-focused. For Zet Zillions, being a roguelite in nature, we had to find a way to tell the game’s story without constraining gameplay too much. I think we found a sweet spot; hopefully you all will be able to enjoy the game in many different ways, either for the deckbuilding aspect or the crazy story of this universe. Zet Zillions allowed us to work with new mechanics we’re not used to, and to work closely with our community by listening to their comments —we really appreciate the amazing feedback you shared with us during the playtest! We've learned a lot from it and we had much fun making this game.

[h2]Let's show off some concept art[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787243/d9fa02bbc16375884b0d1480503a45b424ee6a08.png[/img]

This was the first concept art for FOAM GUN in this universe. I knew that I wanted her to wear a military outfit and an eye patch from the start. If you know her from her Wolfstride days, you will notice her hair color has been switched. In our previous game, the back of her hair was white, and the front black; now in Zet Zillions, it’s the opposite. Also, the arrows pointing to her eyes are now outward. 

I had this idea of General Foam Gun in my head for a while, and in fact, I was saving it for a board game! But I’m glad we were able to bring her as the main character for Zet Zillions. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787243/a312f4e6fbd131aa2343dd49ea06a9e388557723.png[/img]

DOK has lots of concept arts, but this is the one I like the most. There are lots of details we couldn’t bring to the final game. In the end, we chose a more "punk rock language" for him, a bit less serious than this first concept. 

We knew from the very beginning DOK was gonna be a mad engineer or scientist, but he ended up being both. We also wanted to create a mutant or a furry of some sort. Rolo, our lead programmer, was obsessed with crocodiles at the time, so we decided DOK would be a crocodile, though in his final version, it is often referred to as a dinosaur. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787243/523cf6e4e7cf242cf731b40366048fbc1addc3b1.png[/img]

KID ZIGGY! Where’s kid Ziggy in Zet Zillions?! I don’t know, we forgot to add him to the game, but there’s still hope ([i]wink[/i]).

Truth be told, the first concepts for Ziggy were a disaster. He was just a simple human, very unlikable. He was supposed to look like a villain and a bad person but would be the best member of your crew. So in the end we decided to switch gears and make him cool from the start. We love aliens, ufos and grays, so it was a great fit. 

You can see that the final Ziggy changed a bit from his first form. He seemed a lot more serious in this first concept: now his eyes are bigger and he is friendlier!

The idea behind Kid Ziggy and Graywolf Ziggy is that he changes forms when in contact with different area auras; so he will have different personalities depending on which of these two forms he's at. By the way, I never knew what's on the shoulders of soldiers and stuff, and I was too lazy and dumb to research, so that's why Ziggy ended up with a cleaning brush on his shoulder. 

[h2]What happened to the Wolfstride characters in the Zet Zillions Universe?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787243/0b64c6a21f2b0d188a0459381fa89723c854d555.jpg[/img]

To all of you who played Wolfstride, keep this in mind: This Foam Gun is different from Wolfstride’s Foam Gun. She is our first step into the [i]Foamgunverse[/i]. After all, she is an entity; one could almost say she's [i]a force of nature[/i]...

In Zet Zillions, Foam Gun will be your right arm, your faithful general. Together, you will be part of an army responsible for keeping the universe on the right track. Having Foam Gun as our protagonist has allowed us to dive-deep into her story. You will find out that this version of Foam Gun is a bit less mysterious than her Wolfstride counterpart. 

As for what happened to Wolfstride characters in the Zet Zillions Universe, buckle up. THEY’RE ALL DEAD.

... I mean, Wolfstride takes place in 2017 and Zet Zillions in 2476. Although the Earth we refer to in Wolfstride is the same for Zet Zillions, it’s not the same Earth we live in right now. 

Nah, you know what, I lied. Not all characters are dead. Some of them can’t die, they’re not even organic lifeforms, so… You might find some folks from Wolfstride in Zet Zillions. Keep in mind a long time has gone by though, and they might not be the same ones you remember.

But I’ll give you this: Shade is dead. Like very very dead, and he didn’t die of any diseases or old age.
As for Pineapples, Alban Liege, aka Knife Leopard, I’d say he had a great life. He changed quite a bit from what he was before, but it was all worth it in the end. He died with no regrets.

Well, this is it for today! Hope you have enjoyed this retrospective on Zet Zillions. We'll bring you more exciting news very soon so keep your eyes peeled!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2229560

notes.title: Play the Zet Zillions demo at the Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
Do you hear that roar in the distance? It's the Steam Next Fest coming up with TONS of demos.

Lucky for you, there is only one you will wanna play over and over: Ours!

That's right! Not a playtest this time, but [b]our very first demo will be available on February 5th,[/b] improved and polished with the feedback all our amazing testers shared with us. A thunderous THANK YOU to you, you know who you are. You rock!

Is there something new, you say? Would you enjoy playing again if you were part of the playtest?

H*** YEAH you will.

We have new enemies, new art and VFX, new card fusions, and a guaranteed +582% more pineapples. 

And that's not the only thing we'll have during the Next Fest! We will host two special livestreams:

[list]
[*] On [b]February 6th, at 9AM PT / 6PM CET,[/b] our CM Gemma will stream the demo 

[*] And on [b]February 8th, at 8AM PT / 5PM CET,[/b] Ota Imon, Game Director, and Paul Wilson, Game Producer, will join forces to teach Gemma a thing or two about deckbuilding and save her from future embarrassment. If you wanna learn the basics of the genre and about what makes Zet Zillions unique, don't miss this one!
[/list]
